name: hospital-queue-backend
//scripts: The backend is TypeScript and runs from `dist`. `prestart` is what keeps the production deploy working without touching Render's dashboard: npm runs it automatically before `start`, so whatever build command Render is configured with, `npm start` compiles first and boots the compiled entry.
//@careeai/shared: Declared as a file: dependency here AND as a root workspace. The workspace link is what makes `npm install` at the repo root work; this entry is what makes `npm install` run INSIDE backend/ work too. Render's build command lives in its dashboard rather than this repo, so which of the two it runs is not knowable from here — and a backend that cannot resolve its field-normalization module fails at require time, on boot, in production.
